title: Agent Manager adds mouse control without losing terminal behaviour
friendlyTitle: Agent Manager makes many coding-agent sessions easier to control
summary: Agent Manager 0.38.0 adds clicking, double-click focus, scrolling, split resizing, text selection and link opening to its tmux-based interface for multiple agent sessions. Its implementation records the geometry actually drawn on each frame and lets users disable mouse reporting when they prefer native terminal selection.
friendlySummary: Agent Manager now supports clicking, scrolling, resizing and text selection in its terminal interface. Users can turn the mouse support off if they prefer normal terminal behaviour.
whyItMatters: Running several coding agents is increasingly an interface and supervision problem, not merely a model problem. Small controls that keep focus, selection and session identity predictable can reduce accidental input to the wrong agent, while the opt-out preserves established keyboard and terminal workflows.
friendlyWhyItMatters: When several AI agents run at once, it is easy to send a command to the wrong session. Clear controls help people supervise the work more safely.
